data.scope: Selected raw evidence and executed-source snapshots for the benchmark workflow qualification. PNGs and original archives are identified by their quality/comparison records. Not an exhaustive inventory of every pilot or disposable transfer.
data.source_limit: Earlier Windows class-only deployments need the preserved local source/build bridge; final Windows deployment includes source. Dependency/tool caches are explicit, not independent backups.

data.limits: IO/readback included here; excluded from acceptance timing. Brief defects between sampled frames can be missed. Human perceptual review required.
